_help: FreeTV Garden Sponsored panel. Put this file in the ROOT of your data repo (freetvgarden-data-v2) as sponsored.json. Edit -> Commit -> live in a few minutes. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Remove an ad by deleting its block or setting "active": false. If NO entry is active, the Sponsored button hides itself automatically.

RAW HTML AD CODE - paste your ad network's code into "html" as ONE line. Escape every double quote inside it as \" (or use single quotes in the ad code) and write line breaks as \n. 'height' = pixel height of the ad box.
